name: BROK: Natal Tail, A New Christmas Special
description:
When students Graff and Ott are invited to celebrate "Natal Untail," a twisted take on Atlasia's ancient tradition, they'll discover that even in a decaying world, the greatest treasures are the values of sharing and friendship.

This "Special" release adds interactivity through choices and consequences, designed exclusively for consoles.

- A 2-hour visual novel, perfect for reading with kids
- Meet vibrant, animated characters from the BROK universe
- Autoplay mode or read at your own pace
- Choices can lead to fun surprises...or mischief!
- Unlockable in-game achievements
- Text fully localized in 9 languages

Part of the BROK the InvestiGator universe, this prequel introduces key characters and can be enjoyed as a standalone story.
